## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the user problem and what this change does. Link the relevant issue, if any.

## Verification

List the checks actually run, their results, and any unverified behavior. Include desktop/mobile screenshots and keyboard checks for UI changes.

## Content and rights, if relevant

Link original sources and applicable permissions. Explain whether medical text, review evidence, media, or release inputs change. Do not replace approval digests to bypass a failing gate.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] Changes are focused; both README languages agree where relevant.
- [ ] Checks and limitations above describe actual results, including demo checks if changed.
- [ ] No private information, credentials, or unlicensed third-party assets were added.
- [ ] Existing reviews and release gates remain intact; no production deployment is implied.
